description: Deep-link generation for approval-pending notifications that points directly to the approval step in the web UI (not just the run page). Extends the existing deep link mechanism to support step-specific anchors so clicking a notification takes the user straight to the pending approval checkpoint.
steps: Extend src/web/run-deep-link.ts: add approvalDeepLink(runId: string, stepId: string): string that returns '#run-<uuid>?step=<stepId>' (or a similar format that encodes both the run and the target step). Add parseDeepLink(hash: string): { runId: string; stepId?: string } | null that handles both the existing #run-<uuid> format and the new #run-<uuid>?step=<stepId> format. Keep parseRunDeepLink as-is for backward compatibility but mark it as using the new parser internally.
Update src/web/reducer.ts to export the new approvalDeepLink and parseDeepLink functions so they are available in the browser's SteamtrainReducer global.

In src/workflow/notify.ts, modify the notifyWorkflowEvent function's approval_pending case: when meta.url is set, generate the URL using the approval step-specific deep link format instead of the generic run deep link. The url in the notification should point to #run-<runId>?step=<stepId> so clicking it opens that specific approval.
Update src/web/runs.ts where notifyMeta is constructed: ensure the url format still works with the new deep link pattern (the base URL without hash is what the notification formatter appends to).

In src/web/public/app.js, update the hashchange handler and openRunDeepLink() to parse the new format: when a stepId is present in the deep link, after attaching to the run, automatically open the detail drawer for that step (call openDetail with the matching phase/step). Add a new function openRunStepDeepLink(runId, stepId) that first resolves the run (attach or open history), then once the run state is loaded, scrolls to and opens the step detail for the approval checkpoint.

Write tests in tests/run-deep-link.test.ts for the new format: parsing '#run-<uuid>?step=gate-1' returns both runId and stepId, parsing the old format still works, malformed step params are ignored gracefully.
Update existing tests in tests/notify.test.ts to verify that approval-pending events produce step-specific URLs when the meta.url is set.
acceptance_criteria: Approval-pending notifications include a URL that points to #run-<uuid>?step=<stepId> (not just #run-<uuid>)
Clicking such a deep link in the web UI attaches to the run AND opens the approval step's detail drawer
The existing #run-<uuid> deep link format continues to work unchanged (backward compatible)
parseRunDeepLink still works for consumers that only care about the runId
The webhook payload (all formats: raw, slack, discord, teams) includes the step-specific URL for approval events
All new and existing tests pass, typecheck passes, lint passes
